title: Nimble Middle-Eastern Fennel Warak Enab
description: A yeasty, crumbly Middle-Eastern dish featuring fennel and binchotan charcoal, all in one pot.
instructions: Combine yeast, flour, salt, and black pepper in a bowl to make the dough.
Heat the binchotan charcoal in the oven at 400C for 30 minutes to get it smoldering.
Grease a large cast-iron skillet with olive oil.
Add chopped leeks and minced garlic to the skillet and saut���eacute; for 5 minutes.
Add the smoldering binchotan charcoal to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the fennel bulbs to the skillet, cut into wedges, and cook for 10 minutes.
Cover the skillet with a tight-fitting lid and bake in the oven at 375C for 25 minutes.
The dough is ready when it's puffed and golden brown, so remove the lid and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Cut the warm Warak Enab into wedges and serve hot.
